items.source: Abstract SessionFactory implementation that routes AbstractRoutingSessionFactory.getSession() calls to one of various target factories based on a lookup key.
items.translation: 一个实现了 SessionFactory 的抽象类，它会根据查找键将 AbstractRoutingSessionFactory.getSession() 调用路由到多个目标 factories 中的某一个。

items.source: SessionFactoryLookup implementation based on a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于 Spring BeanFactory 的SessionFactoryLookup实现。

items.source: Exception to be thrown by a SessionFactoryLookup implementation, indicating that the specified SessionFactory could not be obtained.
items.translation: 由 SessionFactoryLookup 实现抛出的异常，表示无法获取指定的SessionFactory。

items.source: An implementation of SessionFactoryLookup that simply wraps a single given SessionFactory, returned for any session factory name.
items.translation: 一个实现了SessionFactoryLookup的类，它简单地包装了一个给定的SessionFactory，并针对任何会话工厂名称返回该工厂。

items.source: Provides a strategy for looking up SessionFactory.
items.translation: 提供查找SessionFactory的策略。

items.source: Simple SessionFactoryLookup implementation that relies on a map for doing lookups.
items.translation: 一个简单的SessionFactoryLookup实现，该实现依赖 Map 进行查找。

items.source: Strategy interface for looking up SessionFactory by name.
items.translation: 按名称查找SessionFactory的策略接口。

items.source: Provides utility classes for simple CqlSession access and various session implementations.
items.translation: 提供用于简单访问 CqlSession 和各种会话实现的工具类。

items.source: Provides extensible support for initializing databases through scripts.
items.translation: 提供通过脚本初始化数据库的可扩展支持。
